title: Solvable dynamical model of in-context learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.00921v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Pretrained Transformer architectures display a surprising in-context learning ability without additional training. How the learning process guides the network to achieve this intriguing capability remains unsolved. In this study, we focus on a single-layer single-head linear attention model, where an empirical risk minimization is defined for learning. Given a finite number of training examples, we determine the exact solution of network-parameter dynamics, which is linked to the training error and generalization error, characterizing how memorization and generalization emerge from learning and how these transitions are related to curvatures of the empirical risk landscape. Furthermore, we calculate a data-dependent free energy, from which the training and generalization errors in the long time limit of learning dynamics can be well predicted. Our work adds insights toward understanding the mechanism of in-context learning especially

translated_title: 可求解的上下文学习动力学模型
translated_abstract: 预训练的Transformer架构无需额外训练即可展现出令人惊讶的上下文学习能力。然而，学习过程如何引导网络获得这一引人入胜的能力仍未被解决。在本研究中，我们聚焦于单层单头线性注意力模型，其中定义了用于学习的经验风险最小化。在给定有限数量训练样本的情况下，我们求得了网络参数动力学的精确解，该解与训练误差和泛化误差相关联，刻画了记忆化与泛化如何从学习中涌现，以及这些转变如何与经验风险景观的曲率相关联。此外，我们计算了一个依赖数据的自由能，由此可以很好地预测学习动力学在长时间极限下的训练误差与泛化误差。我们的工作为理解上下文学习的机制提供了新的见解。
tldr: 本研究针对单层单头线性注意力模型精确求解了经验风险最小化下的网络参数动力学，揭示了记忆与泛化如何从学习中涌现及其与风险景观曲率的关系，并通过数据依赖的自由能预测长时间学习动力学下的训练与泛化误差。
en_tdlr: This study derives exact solutions of network-parameter dynamics for a single-layer single-head linear attention model under empirical risk minimization, revealing how memorization and generalization emerge from learning and their connection to the curvature of the empirical risk landscape, while a data-dependent free energy predicts long-time training and generalization errors.
